shortDescription: Send a message to a Cisco Webex Teams Room or Individual

options.name: msg
options.description: The message you would like to send.

options.name: msg_type
options.description: Specifies how you would like the message formatted.

options.name: personal_token
options.description: Your personal access token required to validate the Webex Teams API.

options.name: recipient_id
options.description: The unique identifier associated with the supplied O(recipient_type).

options.name: recipient_type
options.description: The request parameter you would like to send the message to. Messages can be sent to either a room or individual (by ID or E-Mail).
